text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, Bubble Gum Fellow was
earnestly reading through fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Your dignified running is wonderful,
and I'll keep cheering for you forever and ever."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"A resounding proclamation before the race,
born precisely from believing in oneself and having utter confidence in the result—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I want to do my best, just like you,
facing any challenge without flinching."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, this girl is running
for student council at school."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A school where everyone can take pride in their own strengths...
That's an amazing goal to strive for.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"You can't help but cheer unconditionally
for someone who shows the courage to take on a challenge like this!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The student council—is Bubblegum Fellow
just not interested in that sort of thing?
choice_data_list: I think you have an aptitude for it too, though.
I think you have an aptitude for it too, though.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
People do recommend me, yeah. But still,
there are plenty of other folks way better suited for it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I'd rather be the challenger than wait around.
It gets me way more fired up."
choice_data_list: Isn't that not really something to fight over?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, fair point.
You're still hung up on the President's image, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but what matters isn't the title,
it's what the person actually accomplishes, right?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: What I want to do now is take the lead under my own banner and revitalize the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Being a role model for someone or giving someone a push forward,
that kind of thing probably isn't my department.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why you can focus on what you really want to do, right?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: What the fans expect is always me running at the very front.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Can't afford to get distracted by other things.
Alright, time to give training my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow felt all the more fired up
by the letters from the fans.
